displayIdentity.body: A living letter and competence from God. Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you? who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.
displayIdentity.title: A living letter and competence from God
